title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 21 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 21)

content.overview: Unless the parties agree otherwise, arbitral proceedings in respect of a particular dispute commence on the date on which a request for that dispute to be referred to arbitration is received by the respondent.
content.glance: Unless the parties agree otherwise, arbitral proceedings in respect of a particular dispute commence on the date on which a request for that dispute to be referred to arbitration is received by the respondent.
content.study:
Section 21 — Commencement of arbitral proceedings

Unless the parties agree otherwise, arbitral proceedings in respect of a particular dispute commence on the date on which a request for that dispute to be referred to arbitration is received by the respondent.

Apply the provision by identifying its operative conditions, procedural stage, connected statutory provisions and precise consequence.
